name: Draft an invoice from a project's unbilled work
description: Drafts an invoice to a project's customer from the project's approved, billable, not yet billed time at its billing rates and its posted billable costs at cost plus markup, exactly as a person's Draft an invoice on the project's Unbilled tab does: one line a person and rate for the time, one line a cost, each carrying the project, on the revenue account and GST code you give. It is a draft: it posts nothing, issues nothing and moves no money, and the invoice follows the organisation's approval policies when a person issues it. Name the project by the code the person gave you; give no amounts, they come from the records, and the approver sees the customer, the lines and the total before anything is made. Only a time-and-materials project with a customer can be drafted for; refused for an internal project or when nothing is ready to bill.

project.description: The project's code, as the person asking wrote it, such as ACME-01.

revenue_account.description: The code of the active revenue account the invoice's lines earn, as records_search or records_get returned it.

gst_code.description: The GST code of the lines, such as SR.

date.description: The invoice's date, YYYY-MM-DD; leave it out for today.
